refusals.cull: cull(): no tier it may use can run it (webgl2: it runs on the CPU, loop 1 pushes onto an array, which the WebGL2 tier does not run (change 0078)).
refusals.spawn: spawn(): no tier it may use can run it (webgl2: it runs on the CPU, loop 1 pushes onto an array, which the WebGL2 tier does not run (change 0078)).
refusals.play: play(): no tier it may use can run it (webgl2: it runs on the CPU, its GLSL did not emit: glsl-es300: arrayLength has no GLSL ES 3.00 spelling (no storage buffers, no runtime-sized arrays)).
refusals.keep: keep(): no tier it may use can run it (webgl2: it runs on the CPU, loop 1 writes "tape" other than at i).
refusals.tally: tally(): no tier it may use can run it (webgl2: it runs on the CPU, it has no loop to draw).
refusals.plan: cull(): no tier it may use can run it (webgl2: it runs on the CPU, loop 1 pushes onto an array, which the WebGL2 tier does not run (change 0078)).
